Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India  praying to issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to pay the  appropriate compensation amount to the petitioner on determining the value  the land of the petitioner by undergoing the process of fixing the market   be multiplied into 3 times as per the provisions of the Tamil Nadu Highway  2001 and the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisiti  and Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 on taking into consideration  market value of the land thereby pay the 33% deducted amount from the  compensation fixed as per award dated 13.09.2021 with 100% solatium with  admissible rate of interest by way of compensation payable to the petition  respect of the petitioner's Plot Nos.53 and 65 Sri Mahalakshmi Nagar pre  Sri Lakshmi Nagar in S.Nos.335/48D and 335/48E, Thanigaipolur Village,
 Arakkonam Taluk, Ranipet District in an extent of 240 sq.metre pursuant to  representation of the petitioner dated 13.06.2022 made to the respondents   within the time frame fixed by this Court.
 For Petitioner(s) : Mr.K.Venkataramani  Senior Advocate  for Mr.S.Srinivasan  For Respondent(s) : Mr.P.Sathish  Additional Government   ORDER
By consent of learned counsel on both sides, this writ petition is taken up for final disposal at the admission stage itself.

2. The present writ petition is filed praying for a writ of Mandamus to direct the respondents to conclude the enquiry and pass orders on the application dated 25.03.2024 under Section 3H(5) of the National Highways Act, https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 29/08/2025 04:00:05 pm ) 1956.

3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for petitioner that subsequent to the receipt of the representation the District Collector had directed the Special Tahsildar to take appropriate action on the above representation vide proceedings dated 07.07.2020, and that thereafter there has not been any progress.
Hence, this writ petition.

sentences.text: 4. It is submitted by Mr.P.Sathish

learned Additional Government Pleader for respondents would submit that the Special Tahsildar would consider and pass appropriate orders after affording the petitioner a reasonable opportunity of hearing and thereafter submit a report to the District Collector, who on receipt of such report would take appropriate action.
Agreed to by the learned counsel for petitioner.

5. In view thereof, the writ petition stands disposed of with a direction to the Special Tahsildar to consider and pass appropriate orders after affording the petitioner and other interested parties a reasonable opportunity of hearing and thereafter submit a report to the District Collector, who on receipt of such report shall take appropriate action.
